integrity: The proof uses only the published base parameters [8,6,2]_3 and [8,2,6]_3, the definition of lifting, and elementary syndrome/projective-line counting. The cited arXiv full text was inspected at the theorem, table, and conjecture. Literature search cannot prove global novelty.
scientific_limitations: The result settles only the D5 branch of the source conjecture; it does not settle D3, D4, or the separate lifted-code/dual multiplicity conjecture. The general theorem is proved algebraically; exhaustive computation is only a finite anchor at Q=9.
title: Constant deep-hole multiplicity in the lifted eight-coordinate Golay family
